purpose: Teach: 双眼鏡/冷や汗/有難い/北口/出だし/オリジナリティ/平地/飛び降り

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、観察会で、本気で、絶対、双眼鏡、絶対、使ったよね
lines.en: Riku — you actually used those binoculars at the observation event, didn't you?
lines.style: Bright, teasing opening. Quick rhythm, like she's caught him in something small. Warm underneath the call-out. Eyes bright.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。試験前、本気で、絶対、俺、絶対、冷や汗、絶対、止まらないんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Before the test though — I was sweating bullets the whole time, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry half-laugh. Self-deprecating. Admits the anxiety without making it heavy. Dry delivery, like he's used to his own nervousness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、応援、絶対、有難い、絶対、と、絶対、思ってるよ、リク
lines.en: I'm really grateful for how much you were rooting for me, you know.
lines.style: Sincere, quiet breakthrough. Drops the surface-level banter. Direct eye contact implied. Soft but steady — no wavering.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 駅の、本気で、絶対、北口、絶対、で、絶対、待ち合わせ、絶対、しような、桜
lines.en: Let's meet up at the north exit of the station, yeah?
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Not quite changing the subject but softening the moment. Practical, grounded. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前のスピーチの、本気で、絶対、出だし、絶対、印象的だったよ、リク
lines.en: The way you started your speech really stuck with people, by the way.
lines.style: Warm observation, like she's been thinking about it. Unhurried delivery. Genuine praise, no performance. Sincere eye contact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の作文、本気で、絶対、オリジナリティ、絶対、あるよな、桜
lines.en: Your essay actually had real originality to it, you know?
lines.style: Appreciative, steady voice. Not over-the-top. Sincere without being heavy. The kind of compliment that lands because it's specific.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活合宿で、本気で、絶対、平地、絶対、ランニング、絶対、続けてるよ、リク
lines.en: You've been keeping up with your running on flat ground during club camp, haven't you?
lines.style: Animated observation, light and encouraging. Quick energy but not mocking. The tone of someone noticing and approving of effort.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 体育で、本気で、絶対、跳び箱から、絶対、飛び降りる、絶対、こと、絶対、できたぜ、桜
lines.en: You actually managed to jump off the vault in PE class — that's something.
lines.style: Proud closing beat. Warm recognition. Small sense of 'I knew you could.' Gentle, affirming. Slight exhale of satisfaction.
